strapiBlog.title: Alta Real Estate Partners with Maison Margiela to Launch the Brand’s First Residences in Dubai
strapiBlog.short_description: Alta Real Estate Development has announced a partnership with the acclaimed Parisian fashion house Maison Margiela to create the world’s first Maison Margiela Residences in Dubai.

data.text:
Alta Real Estate Development has announced a partnership with the acclaimed Parisian fashion house Maison Margiela to create the world’s first Maison Margiela Residences in Dubai. Set to be developed on Palm Jumeirah, this exclusive project marks the Maison’s debut in the world of branded residences, redefining the intersection of fashion and real estate.

As anticipation builds ahead of the official launch, let’s take a closer look at what makes this development the most highly-awaited branded residences in Dubai.

About Maison Margiela’s First-Ever Residences

Comprising just 24 bespoke residences, the development will embody Maison Margiela’s avant-garde design philosophy, one that challenges convention and celebrates creativity, craftsmanship, and individuality. Each home will be envisioned as a work of art, blending the Maison’s distinctive design codes with Alta’s architectural precision to deliver a living experience unlike any other. 

Inquire About Maison Margiela Residences

Abdulla Al Tayer, Managing Director of Alta Real Estate Development, commented on the collaboration:

“Partnering with Maison Margiela represents a shared vision to push the boundaries of design and redefine what luxury living means in Dubai. Together, we are creating a residential experience that embodies creativity, individuality, and exceptional craftsmanship.”

As part of Alta’s growing portfolio of partnerships with world-renowned brands, Maison Margiela Residences showcases the developer’s continued commitment to curating properties that seamlessly integrate global design leadership with Dubai’s vibrant real estate landscape. The project will be situated in one of Palm Jumeirah’s most prestigious waterfront plots, offering panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf and Dubai’s skyline.

Founded in 1988 by Belgian designer Martin Margiela, the Maison has long been revered for its deconstructivist approach to fashion, blurring the lines between form and function, past and present. 

By combining Alta’s architectural craftsmanship with Maison Margiela’s artful innovation, the collaboration is poised to set a new benchmark for luxury living. The world’s first Maison Margiela Residences, a new addition to the portfolio of branded residences in Dubai, are not just homes; they represent a new dialogue between haute couture and architecture.

data.answer: Maison Margiela Residences will officially launch on 21st October 2025.
